items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 18th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 70 while the rest average 25 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 70/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: Holders ~24% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.76: price is 24% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.503). Yet 56% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.621 is 2.7σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: -83% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: One wallet scooped 8 AEON over 2 days
items.detail: 0xb744…337d is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 3.6 ETH ($9,596), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 8 AEON (~$9,596) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.
items.checkable: Net marketplace buys minus sells per wallet over 30 days, from the public sale log.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.76 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.76 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: -84% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.46; price sits -84% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,050 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,354 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: NUPL -0.32 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.32 (from MVRV 0.76) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-16.6% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.81M SPX. 4w -14.5% · 12w -16.6% · 26w -21.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-16.6% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: Risk crossed below 0.1 — now 0.08
items.detail: The rainbow risk (0 = fire-sale floor, 1 = euphoria) is 0.08, down from 0.12 a week ago.
items.framing: Model risk is 0.08 — it just crossed 0.1. Low = the accumulation end; the levels card shows exactly where.
items.checkable: Log-residual of price vs the frozen model, min-max normalised over full history.

items.headline: Losses being locked in
items.detail: Net realized loss today is 1.9σ from normal — coins are moving at a loss more than usual.
items.framing: Loss-realisation spiked on-chain today (1.9σ). A behaviour read from what coins realised when they moved.
items.checkable: Realized P&L from the FIFO engine per moved coin.

items.headline: -1.2σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.2σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.2σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SOPR 0.725 — coins moving at a loss
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 0.725: coins that moved on-chain realised a loss on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — loss-realisation (SOPR 0.725).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.

items.headline: Supply is spreading out of the top 100
items.detail: Top-100 share is 55.9% of holder supply, 1.7σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (55.9%, 1.7σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.
